description: This PHP source file defines the RelationshipFactory class, which is responsible for creating instances of various relationship types (OneToOne, OneToMany, ManyToOne, ManyToMany) based on provided relationship definitions within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM module. It includes logic for handling different relationship types and requiring appropriate class files accordingly.

classes.name: RelationshipFactory
classes.description: A factory class used to instantiate specific relationship objects based on a given relationship definition. Handles creating relationships of types OneToOne, OneToMany, ManyToOne, and ManyToMany, with defaulting to ManyToMany.

methods.name: newRelationship
methods.description: Creates and returns a new relationship object based on the provided relationship definition array. Defaults to a ManyToMany relationship if no type is specified, and requires the appropriate class file before instantiation.
